benchmark: v3 capped combat versus v4 timed attacks and distinct guardians, exact gameplay simulation

version_definitions.v3: The candidate/capped version retained in balance_results.json, not that file's old uncapped baseline.
version_definitions.v4: Timed sword/bow/cast and enemy windup/active/recovery states, no passive enemy contact damage, four distinct guardian attack sets.

campaigns.choices: Greedy damage/speed/range strategy chooses only from actual offered buttons; wholly ineffective upgrades are deprioritized. Relics selected from actual three offers.
campaigns.controls: Kiting with ordinary collision movement, bullet avoidance, and normal emergency dash. Dash build also dashes offensively.
campaigns.limitations: Small seeded automated sample, not a human difficulty assessment. Obstacle/controller stalls can leave surviving enemies. Old/new offers differ because RNG implementation and eligible pools changed; independent encounter arena geometry is matched by arena_seed.
campaigns.outcomes: Cleared, died, or still alive at the 120-second timeout. A timeout is not a death; clear-time medians exclude timeouts/deaths.
campaigns.progression: Natural full run: real attacks, XP, drops and healing; no injected kills or health resets. Automatic center-portal entry only after combat and all rewards.

additional_paths.choices: Greedy damage/speed/range strategy chooses only from actual offered buttons; wholly ineffective upgrades are deprioritized. Relics selected from actual three offers.
additional_paths.controls: Kiting with ordinary collision movement, bullet avoidance, and normal emergency dash. Dash build also dashes offensively.
additional_paths.limitations: Small seeded automated sample, not a human difficulty assessment. Obstacle/controller stalls can leave surviving enemies. Old/new offers differ because RNG implementation and eligible pools changed; independent encounter arena geometry is matched by arena_seed.
additional_paths.outcomes: Cleared, died, or still alive at the 120-second timeout. A timeout is not a death; clear-time medians exclude timeouts/deaths.
additional_paths.progression: Natural full run: real attacks, XP, drops and healing; no injected kills or health resets. Automatic center-portal entry only after combat and all rewards.

encounters.choices: Greedy damage/speed/range strategy chooses only from actual offered buttons; wholly ineffective upgrades are deprioritized. Relics selected from actual three offers.
encounters.controls: Ordinary collision movement; no dash. Horizontal reverses at arena edges/obstacles; pursue follows the closest enemy.
encounters.limitations: Small seeded automated sample, not a human difficulty assessment. Obstacle/controller stalls can leave surviving enemies. Old/new offers differ because RNG implementation and eligible pools changed; independent encounter arena geometry is matched by arena_seed.
encounters.outcomes: Cleared, died, or still alive at the 120-second timeout. A timeout is not a death; clear-time medians exclude timeouts/deaths.
encounters.progression: Independent healthy-entry encounters: preceding stages supply their exact total dropped XP and legal random three-option rewards. HP is set to normal maximum at entry. No injected kills or HP changes in measured combat; this is not a prior-stage survival result.

limitations: Automated small samples are not human fairness or human win-rate evidence.
Natural campaign combat changes consumption of RNG, so nominal seeds do not guarantee matched terrain/rewards beyond initial conditions.
Guardian-arena clear time includes all enemies; it is not isolated boss time-to-kill.
Time budgets are 120 seconds per arena. A live controller timeout is not a death.
Clear-time medians only include successful clears. Campaign total-combat medians only include all-20 completions.
Minimum HP is absolute minimum HP divided by entry HP. Normal leveling can increase maximum HP.

preservation_checks.life_drain: Unique nonstacking 10% of actual dealt damage; level growth excludes lifesteal, clamp caps it at 0.1.
preservation_checks.potions: Every herbalist drops 2%/4%/6% maximum-HP healing with 60%/30%/10% odds.
preservation_checks.arena_clear_heal: 10% of maximum HP, once per cleared arena, cannot revive a dead player.
preservation_checks.level_heal: 12 HP capped by normal maximum HP.
preservation_checks.stat_caps: damage 80, sword range 145, attack_speed 2.2, speed 240, HP 400, armor 8, regen 3, projectiles 4, magic 3, dash_damage 120, dash cooldown floor 1.1, pickup 240; upgrade rank caps/diminishing returns unchanged.

delivery_source_verification.explanation: The full benchmark ran against the recorded v4 source hashes. Later edits only changed rendering. Source comparison confirms every non-rendering main/combat function and preamble remains byte-identical; delivery hashes below identify the verified rendering revision.

character_art.gd.scope: Presentation only, no combat or progression update calls.

failure_diagnostics.method: Read-only snapshots every 10 simulated seconds in a temporary copy of the unchanged harness. Actual gameplay scripts are unchanged. All 60 diagnostic outcome rows exactly match the authoritative final encounter suite. Last three snapshots retained for each uncleared encounter.
failure_diagnostics.campaigns: All 17 full campaigns completed all 20 arenas; no campaign failures to diagnose.
failure_diagnostics.encounters: The 11 live timeouts retain ordinary enemies outside the horizontal controller's attack reach or on the far side of obstacles. Straight-line enemy movement does not route around obstacles. Horizontal control never leaves y = 340 and makes no evasive dash. The sole death, Ranger seed 1760 stage 5, followed prolonged surviving archer fire after the guardian was defeated; snapshots show the remaining grunt outside melee distance and the two archers outside sword range. No boss remains in any failure snapshot.
